options.label: current - release the version already in the files (first release)

inputs.description: One-line release note. Leave EMPTY if the notes are already under '## [Unreleased]' in CHANGELOG.md, or if you chose 'current'.
Preview, or release for real? Releasing commits, tags and pushes; GitHub Actions then publishes to PyPI, and a PyPI version can never be replaced.

options.label: Preview - run every check, change nothing
RELEASE for real - bump, verify, commit, tag, push, publish

tasks.label: Release
tasks.detail: One task for the whole release: bump version + changelog, lint/tests/docs/build, commit only the release files, tag, push. GitHub Actions publishes to PyPI. Asks Preview vs real (default: Preview).
